## AccountUpdateInput.emptyTrashFrequency property

Number of days before messages in the trash are permanently deleted (0 = delete on quit, -1 = never delete). Cannot be reset: null is rejected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
emptyTrashFrequency?: Integer;
```
